items.title: 《魔兽世界》永远是魔兽世界历史上最大规模的发布
items.summary: Even during the beta, World of Warcraft Forever was shaping up to be huge, with an unprecedented amount of tes

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/wow-1790594365869.jpg

Even during the beta, World of Warcraft Forever was shaping up to be huge, with an unprecedented amount of testers. Over the weekend, Blizzard announced that World of Warcraft Forever had the biggest launch in WoW history.

The news came over X/Twitter, where the official World of Warcraft account posted that Forever was the biggest launch in WoW history, both in terms of peak concurrent players and the number of returning players. Keep in mind that this history includes Wrath of the Lich King and Warlords of Draenor, both of which had huge launches – though the latter didn't exactly maintain it.

WoW Forever didn't just break records by dragging old players in and convincing them to resub. Holly Longdale, Blizzard's executive producer and vice president for World of Warcraft, posted her own statistic , saying, "Another statistic is filling our hearts – we are seeing the most NEW players for a WoW launch in 15 years!" That means WoW Forever has brought more players in than any WoW expansion since Cataclysm first launched 16 years ago in 2010.

Congratulations everyone, you made HISTORY! WoW: Forever has achieved: 🔹The biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players 🔹The highest number of returning players in WoW history This is all because of you, the players. From all of us, THANK YOU! https://t.co/MQxQXmNDbA

Scrolling through Longdale's replies, it's clear that people are loving WoW Forever. There are a ton of fans talking about how they played all weekend, like Dungeons and Dragons senior game designer Joey Haeck , who posted a picture of himself on a Zeppelin leaving Orgrimmar, saying, "Congratulations to the whole Forever team! I'm having a blast on every packed zeppelin and every open vista."

While we here at IGN don't have a full review yet, our early review is positive, with reviewer Len Hafer talking about her beta experience , saying, "I ended my beta journey at level 13, gazing out across the dusty plains of Westfall, because I didn't want to spoil too much for myself before the big day. But from what I have seen so far? I think they might have done it. They made me believe I can go home again – and that home is somewhere I want to spend more time, with new surprises to discover. Let's see if they can keep it up for 47 more levels. Watch this space for updates in the weeks to come."

While it's obviously been a huge success, Blizzard had been cooking World of Warcraft Forever on the back burner for a while, only pulling the trigger on its full development after it saw how successful Season of Discovery was back in 2023 . Even with the massive load of players logging in at launch, WoW Forever had an extremely smooth launch , thanks to running on a massive amount of hardware . There was even a race to max level, which took three whole days before someone hit the level cap of 60 .

items.title: 10.2.2b 后端补丁
items.summary: Towards the end of October, we released a small balance patch using our new Backend Tunables system, adjusting

content.v: Towards the end of October, we released a small balance patch using our new Backend Tunables system, adjusting The Executioner and The Good Guy. After working through your feedback and watching both of them in action, we’d like to further refine those changes.

First, let’s get a quick recap of what the Backend Tunables system even is. Put simply, it’s a system that allows us to put small balance changes in your hands quicker, without having to wait for full patch releases. Currently, the system lets us make adjustments to many of our Killers (we’re adding support for more over time) and basekit values. While add-ons and perks aren’t currently supported, this is something we have planned for the future.
Now, what’s changing today?
The Executioner:
Increased the delay between each segment of Punishment of the Damned to 0.015s (was 0.001s)

Dev note: The previous reduction to 0.001s made it a little too efficient, especially when paired with the Iridescent Seal of Metatron add-on. This is a great example of why we intend to add add-on support to Backend Tunables, because sometimes, basekit changes will end up synergizing more than we expected.
The Good Guy:
Decreased the time to Scamper under Pallets (during Slice & Dice) to 0.8s (was 1s)
Dev note: Some of you pointed out that Scamper under Pallets was not the same as Scamper on vaults. We've adjusted the duration to be the same for both.
As a reminder, this update does not require a download of any new content, however players will need to restart their game for the changes to take effect.

items.title: DC工作室将聘请一位漫威老将来取代詹姆斯·冈恩和彼得·萨夫兰
items.summary: DC Studios co-presidents James Gunn and Peter Safran have officially announced they'll step down, and Marvel v

content.v: DC Studios co-presidents James Gunn and Peter Safran have officially announced they'll step down, and Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham will replace them. Gunn and Safran architected the new DC Universe of films and TV series, and they also had ambitious plans to expand the DCU into video games. Latcham is no stranger to superhero cinema, with credits on several of Marvel's biggest projects, including Spider-Man, Guardians of the Galaxy, and Avengers.

"Four years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision. In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker, Creature Commandos, Lanterns and Clayface," Gunn and Safran wrote in a statement (via Variety ). "We're immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with. We’ve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and we’re eager to see the perspective he brings to DC’s next chapter. We’re excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lex’s journey in Man of Tomorrow."

Following the relaunch of the DC Universe in film, Gunn later spoke about the potential of cross-platform storytelling, saying actors would portray their characters across all forms of media—including video games. "We have a couple of little DC games coming out. But we also have talked about–and in early stages of planning--some bigger things," Gunn said in 2025 . "One thing in particular I’m excited about, but it does take time."

We never got to hear David Corenswet reprise his role as Superman in a video game, and since then, big changes have happened behind the scenes. Paramount’s $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery was approved earlier this year, leading to a merger between Warner Bros. Interactive (the WB division that publishes video games based on the company's IP) and Paramount Games Studio.

While the ambitious plans for the video game side of DC Studios never materialized, Gunn and Safran were still busy building a new DC Universe for the big and small screen. Three feature films were released--Superman, Supergirl, and Clayface--while the TV side saw multiple animated and live-action projects like Lanterns, Creature Commandos, and Peacemaker. Next year's big project is the Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow, which Gunn wrote and co-directed, and The People v. Gorilla Grodd is an upcoming series that will see Skyler Gisondo back as Jimmy Olsen.
On the video game side, Rocksteady is rumored to be working on a new single-player Batman game .

items.title: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛重制版》数据挖掘者发现了马吉拉面具的潜力，Master Quest DLC 提示
items.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time players are getting their hopes up after dataminers uncovered hints of Ma

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/the-legend-of-zelda-majoras-mask-1794247669810.png

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time players are getting their hopes up after dataminers uncovered hints of Master Quest DLC – and maybe even some Majora's Mask content – tucked in the files of Nintendo's new remake.

It's not been one week since Nintendo reimagined one of the most critically acclaimed games of all time for Nintendo Switch 2, and while some players are tearing it apart to look for glitches , others are digging even deeper. One of the first things dataminers did was sift through Ocarina of Time's files, and surprisingly, there may be some clues as to what remake plans Nintendo has in the cards.

There's a good chance you're here to see why we're talking about Majora's Mask today. We'll start by saying that you will want to keep expectations in check until an official announcement is made, but that shouldn't make YouTuber Austin John Plays ' findings any less compelling (via Kotaku ).

Yesterday, the content creator uploaded a video meant to explore the in-game functionality of amiibo for the remake, including unreleased figures, of which there are (officially) two : one for Link, and one for Zelda. Considering the toys-to-life collectibles won't launch until 2027, anyone looking to access the masks they unlock would need to dive into the game's files to use them. This is the path Austin John Plays took – but he found more than just two new masks.

"I was starting to think that this was an Adult Link amiibo that's going to be released in the future," he said, referencing data containing strange, unused NPC dialogue. "I'm starting to not think that. I have a feeling this is one of those videos that I put it out, and in three years, I'm going to go like, 'Look! See? Crazy Austin? Crazy Austin was right!"

The code he referenced in the video alludes to characters calling out Link for wearing a "rare" and "otherworldly." Others call it "strange," with NPC Dampé even saying, "What's with that mask? Lookin' at it makes me feel weird." We do not know what this secret mask looks like or if the text tied to it will ever amount to anything…but with so much data on the backend, you can see why many believe Nintendo has already completed some amount of Majora's Mask content for some reason.

Again, this is all far from hard evidence, and even if it did point to something related to Majora's Mask, it's hard to say exactly what it may be. Austin John Plays theorizes the data we see here could be tied to a yet-to-be-announced Skull Kid amiibo for a yet-to-be-announced Majora's Mask remake. The idea here is that, like their Nintendo 64 counterparts, Nintendo's work on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake may have allowed it to quickly develop another remake based on Majora's Mask.

There's also the chance that Nintendo could simply release a standalone Skull Kid amiibo. The data could also point to another unique mask entirely – or it could point to nothing at all. Meanwhile, Bluesky user and dataminer @mrcheeze.github.io found their own clues that point to something entirely different: the return of Master Quest.

Master Quest is a remixed, harder mode for the original N64 Ocarina of Time that launched with the GameCube re-release. It reappeared with the Nintendo 3DS remake and then was confusingly absent from the Switch 2 remake. MyCheeze's findings suggest Nintendo could have plans to add it during an update, but dataminer @OatmealDome reported that their findings suggest players will need to own additional DLC in order to access it.

While Nintendo could distribute the DLC for free, I don't see why they went to the effort to make it be unlocked by DLC instead of just including it in an update... (w/ thanks to MrCheeze for initial finding) 🦋 https://t.co/aWXyQTJ5Uk https://t.co/uMFAkhHdhX

Now, don't get all upset yet; we don't know if this alleged Master Quest DLC will have any particular cost tied to it. It could be $5 or even $20, or it could be some sort of bundle expansion. Nintendo has been known to offer add-on content via certain Nintendo Online subscription tiers, with one of the better examples being Switch 2 upgrades for both The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom .

Oatmeal Dome also added that, based on their findings, the incomplete data also contained references to Master Quest featuring a mirrored world and modified dungeons. Again, it's been only about four days since The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake came to Switch 2. We will only know more with time, so don't go expecting Nintendo to announce Master Quest DLC or a Majora's Mask remake any time soon.

While we wait, you can read our review of the game here , or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. Be sure to check out our expanding Ocarina of Time remake Walkthrough for comprehensive guides on each main quest area and dungeon, plus where to get Early Heart Pieces, Early Gold Skulltulas , and Early Item Bag Expansions . If you're looking for more, don't miss our complete guides to All Pieces of Heart , All Gold Skulltulas , and All Empty Bottles .

items.title: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》玩家在游戏中创作令人难以置信的翻唱歌曲
items.summary: For fantasy nerds, it's hard to top The Legend of Zelda video game series and Lord of the Rings film trilogy.

content.v: For fantasy nerds, it's hard to top The Legend of Zelda video game series and Lord of the Rings film trilogy. If that's you, like it is me, then X user Seven will probably give you goosebumps with his cover of "Concerning Hobbits" in-game with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . Watching young Link recreate the iconic song from The Fellowship of the Ring movie just works perfectly as a crossover (which you can see below).

That's not the only song people are recreating in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, though. On Reddit , a person posted the child Hylian playing the intro to Linkin Park's "In the End." Obviously, that might not be as complementary to the game's setting as a Lord of the Rings tune, but it slaps nonetheless. And it's probably more likely to get stuck in your head.

Meanwhile, it was a couple of months ago at this point, but that didn't stop DaJaVo on Instagram from making a new rendition of Earth, Wind, & Fire's "September" in Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The content creator hinted that this was not easy to pull off, as they asked: "Guess how much practice this took."

Probably the most hilarious and last cover we'll spotlight is "Axel F" by Crazy Frog by Instagram user Joey T. Games (seen above). We just wish there was a way for Navi to add in a "bing, bing" in the remake.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time just launched last week on Switch 2, and it's already helped Songbird Ocarina break a sales record for real-life ocarinas . That company's manager, Eric Bernard, previously told GameSpot that the ocarina-playing in the remake is very accurate . The game also reinforces that Nintendo's acquisition of Monolith Soft was one of its wisest moves almost two decades ago .

items.title: AMD 用户报告称，一个失灵的实用程序每月会消耗 SSD 健康状况 1%。 AMD 表示正在对其 GPU 驱动程序进行修复
items.summary: No rush. SSDs are cheap as chips right now, eh?

content.v: I fear opening the Pandora's box that is my SSD's health report. I'd much rather live in ignorance until the day it inevitably fails on me. Some eagle-eyed AMD GPU users, however, have spotted their own SSD health dropping much faster than they expected, and have placed the blame squarely on an AMD Adrenalin driver utility.

Redditor Darklinkpower has flagged the issue on the r/pcmasterrace subbreddit. "I just found out that the driver eats up 1% of my SSD health every month for 16 month," says the redditor, "where[as another] user reported losing approximately 1% of their SSD health every month."

The reports come from multiple sources, including the Radeon subreddit , and Tomasz Gawroński on X , who says that Adrenalin driver utility atieclxx.exe had performed 19.5 GB of I/O writes on their machine in just 12 hours. According to Gawroński, the bug has been present since Adrenalin Edition 26.7.1 released in June of this year.
The issue doesn't appear to be present on all machines, and our own AMD GPU-using Jacob Fox hasn't been able to reproduce it. Still, the reports are numerous enough to suggest something is amiss.

In terms of an official response, representative AMD_Matt on the AMD community forums replied to a user flagging the issue last month, saying "We're looking into it with the aim to resolve it in a future driver release." Another AMD representative on Reddit, AMD_Vik, confirmed the disk write issue " should be fixed " in Adrenalin 26.11.1, although no exact release date has been given beyond its expected arrival later this month.

It seems that AMD is well aware of its misfiring utility, so hopefully the fix is on its way. After all, SSDs are bloomin' expensive at the moment , so I, along with the rest of the PC gaming community, are likely going to be eeking out the ones we've got for some time to come.

items.summary: Gettin' heretical with it.

others.title: 《Rogue Trader》的后续作品《战锤 40,000：黑暗异端》将于 2027 年初发布

content.v: Owlcat has released a new trailer for its coming Warhammer 40K RPG, Dark Heresy. The inquisition and investigation-focused RPG is now slated for a January 28 launch.

We've loved what we've seen of the game so far: Its focus on investigating heresy and closing cases represents something genuinely novel for Owlcat, which until now has focused on fantasies of rulership (with lite 4x/management gameplay) and quite good (and often very challenging) tactical battles.

One problem: I have a largely uncomplicated relationship with Owlcat games, because I've only ever played them a year-plus out from launch. PCG's other RPG heads, like weekend editor Jody Macgregor and online editor Fraser Brown, remain scarred by their experiences with pre-launch, review period Owlcat games. Jody, for example, lost hours of progress while working on his Rogue Trader review, and once told me that Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous' extensive combat system "just didn't work" in the pre-release review period.

Hope springs eternal, though, and I'm a glass half-full type of guy. The corollary to Owlcat games launching rough is that they only get better over time, and the studio has done a phenomenal job supporting its games with both patches and massive story DLCs. Rogue Trader's final add-on, Processional of the Damned , is coming out a month from now on December 8, almost three years to the date after Rogue Trader's initial release.

And after Dark Heresy, there's still the matter of The Expanse: Osiris Reborn. Owlcat is taking its own stab at a Mass Effect-style, sci-fi shooter RPG in the popular setting. How the team is juggling two projects of this magnitude (even at a vastly increased team size) is mind boggling, but I'm just happy to be along for the ride. You can currently wishlist Warhammer 40K: Dark Heresy on Steam .

items.title: BioWare 前执行制作人 Mark Darrah 分享了《龙腾世纪 4》的最初愿景
items.summary: BioWare veteran Mark Darrah has revealed an internal pitch for Dragon Age 4 that was never shared with fans.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/dragon-age-1794243596754.jpg
BioWare veteran Mark Darrah has revealed an internal pitch for Dragon Age 4 that was never shared with fans.

This pitch was shared in the form of a book which Darrah says was distributed within BioWare and to higher ups at EA. The idea behind the book was to “remain relevant” with the publisher, and to try and secure early funding and new hires for the project.

“There's always a fear, and I think a legitimate fear, within a big publishing organization that you will get cancelled or in, the in case of EA, you will simply be allowed to be to remain on a starvation diet to the point where you cannot continue,” Darrah said in a new video published to his YouTube channel .

“This is where ultimately this book comes into being,” he continued. “This was made in mid-2016 to be something that I could give to the team, but also something I could give senior people within the EA organization to say, ‘Look, we're doing a Dragon Age. Don't forget that Dragon Age: Inquisition was a super great game that sold super well, so you want another one, right?’"

The book focusses on what was then referred to as Joplin, the original plan for a fourth Dragon Age game. This was later cancelled in favour of a live service Dragon Age 4, which in turn, was partially scrapped and retooled in the single-player Dragon Age: The Veilguard.

As for Joplin, this book gives us an idea as to what BioWare was cooking behind the scenes. For starters, we can see that there was a chapter on the game having a "reactive world." However, in The Veilguard, reactions to decisions made in previous games were almost entirely scrapped .

Darrah also shared that BioWare envisioned destructable environements, dynamic weather conditions, and social interactions that went beyond the standard BioWare conversations. There’s even a reference to the player taking part in heists, something we haven’t seen in the series before.

With that said, Darrah admitted that many of these features would have been scrapped even if development went well. In fact, BioWare was in the process of phasing out heists in 2017. But it does show us the vision BioWare was chasing, with a desire to make the series much more immersive than previous entries.
While Darrah failed to reveal the full content of the books, he did share the opening he wrote back in 2016:
“Dragon Age: Inquisition has transformed what the franchise is and how it is perceived by the public. As we move forward, we have a great opportunity to continue the breakout we have started.
“We stand upon the foundation laid by Dragon Age: Inquisition. A foundation that lets us see further. To see things that didn't work and fix them, to see things that did work and improve them.

“The Dragon Age team will create a more immersive interactive world with people in it who act and react like real people. We have a lot of work to do, but never has a Dragon Age game started in a stronger place. This document represents our current thinking on the next steps of the franchise.”

Needless to say, the developers did not get the development cycle they were hoping for. Instead, Joplin was scrapped, and Dragon Age stagnated to make way for Mass Effect: Andromeda and Anthem. The Dragon Age series was put on ice after The Veilguard failed to reach EA’s sales targets .

Now, BioWare has been shut down by EA. Many fans are fighting to save BioWare’s work, particularly the now-cancelled Mass Effect Universe, but we certainly shouldn’t expect any developments in the Dragon Age series anytime soon.

items.title: 为 16 年来第一部新的斯科特朝圣者漫画做好准备
items.summary: The first new Scott Pilgrim comic in 16 years is almost upon us. Feast your eyes on this exclusive preview of

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/mixcollage-08-nov-2026-09-33-pm-4861-1794191623880.jpg

2026 may be rapidly winding down, but we're still looking ahead to one of the most eagerly anticipated new comics of the year. Scott Pilgrim EX: Dawn of Metal Scott #1 is the first new comic in the beloved franchise since 2010's Scott Pilgrim's Finest Hour. And luckily, IGN has a new preview of this monumental release.
Check out the slideshow gallery below to see the first seven pages of Scott Pilgrim EX: Dawn of Metal Scott #1:

Scott Pilgrim EX: Dawn of Metal Scott #1 is written and drawn by series creator Bryan Lee O'Malley. The comic serves as a prequel to the recent arcade-style brawling game Scott Pilgrim EX (which also technically makes it a sequel to the 2023 Netflix series Scott Pilgrim Takes Off). Here's the official description for this issue:

“When I was asked to create a minicomic for SCOTT PILGRIM EX, I quickly said yes without considering the implications,” said O’Malley in a statement. “Only when I started writing and drawing it did I realize this would be the first new Scott Pilgrim comic in 16 years. It’s only a trifle, but returning to Scott’s Toronto really did feel like coming home.”
Scott Pilgrim EX: Dawn of Metal Scott #1 will be released on November 11. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .

In IGN's Scott Pilgrim EX review , Will Borger writes, "Scott Pilgrim EX is the latest in a long line of retro revivals from Tribute Games, and like all of its previous works, the developer has done an admirable job of producing a beat ‘em up that builds on its predecessor while adding much appreciated gameplay depth and plenty of replayability. I love EX’s RPG systems (simple as they are), its world, and how there is always another interesting character to try when I get bored. But it’s also a game that grapples with the passage of time, even if it perhaps doesn’t mean to. The modern beat ‘em up exists because of the games that came before, but they were often far more limited. With the passage of time, we’ve returned to those ideas and refined them. Like Scott Pilgrim itself, those games have gone from something that was new to something that is now referenced. Nostalgia is a powerful drug, but a bittersweet one, and Scott Pilgrim EX understands that. You can go back in time, but you can’t go back to the way things were. All that’s left is to appreciate where you’ve been and enjoy what’s here now. And you know what? What’s here is pretty fun."
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

items.title: 更便宜的 OLED 可能会比我们想象的更快出现，因为 TCL 华星光电表示，其新的喷墨打印设备最快将于明年此时投入运行
items.summary: Previous rumours had it penned for 2028.

content.v: TCL CSOT (the subsidiary of TCL that manufactures OLEDs and other panels) says its new inkjet-printed OLED factory has "entered the equipment move-in phase" (via TechPowerUp ) after the project "progressed at a rapid pace". In other words, it's started filling up its production facility with the equipment to produce inkjet OLEDs. Production, the company says, is targeted for about this time next year.

What's the big deal, you ask? It all comes down to that phrase, "inkjet-printed". Inkjet printing (IJP) should be a much more cost-effective way of making OLED panels, which means it should ultimately deliver OLED gaming monitors that are cheaper than traditionally manufactured ones.

Which is saying something, considering how much traditionally manufactured OLEDs have dropped in price over the past year—you can currently pick up a 240 Hz OLED monitor for just $269 at Walmart , for instance. Having OLEDs even cheaper than this will be a whirlwind of fresh air in the current very expensive PC hardware market.

IJP should give us such cheaper panels because the way it makes OLEDs doesn't involve as much wastage. Normally, you have some OLED materials moving through a mask, and some of them are lost. With IJP, however, the materials are printed directly onto the substrate, meaning there shouldn't be any lost materials. Thus, more efficient and cost-effective production.

We'd already heard from third-party sources that this production facility would be producing such cheap OLEDs before long. But that source predicted a start to production in 2028, and TCL is here saying it's targeted for even sooner, in the fourth quarter of 2027.

Whether it ends up being 2027 or 2028, I'm still here for it. We can do with all the good news we can get for PC gaming prices, given the ongoing global memory shortage . Monitors and peripherals seem to be where it's at, and you certainly won't hear me complaining about cheaper, punchy, low-latency displays. Roll on 2027.

items.title: 黄仁勋与被指控的中国间谍的恋情凸显了 GPU 公司的交易现在是每个人的事
items.summary: He used to sell gaming GPUs, now he's in the middle of a geopolitical quagmire.

content.v: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an extramarital affair in a statement published on Nvidia's newsroom . A strange move for the $4.5 trillion company without the added context: the person he's suspected of having an affair with has also been deemed a Chinese intelligence asset by US officials, and was investigated for smuggling none other than Nvidia's own chips.

The story goes far deeper than Huang's affair; revolving around national security, export controls, spying, chip smuggling, and US/China relations. It's in large part about AI, and who controls the hardware that makes it possible. So, if you're wondering why Huang might be the target of Chinese intelligence to begin with, or why he's announcing his affair in the most public way possible, here's how we got to this point.
Why does it matter where Nvidia sells its GPUs?

Nvidia is at the centre of the debate about whether the United States should sell its most technologically advanced chips to China. The US had already ensured China couldn't make the most cutting-edge chips through a ban of Netherlands-based ASML's chipmaking machines. Yet it has also moved between qualified bans of high-performance chips, leading to made-for-China GPUs, such as the RTX 4090D , RTX 5090 D, and H20 ; to outright bans, namely the ongoing restrictions for the Blackwell architecture; Nvidia's latest and greatest.

There have been a lot of changes to export controls between the US and China, going back to Biden's trade war. Limitations were introduced in 2023 that used "weighted teraflops" and "adjusted peak performance" to decide which systems were deemed too good to be sold in China. It also limited specific cards based on their total processing power and performance density, which nixed specific chips such as the RTX 4090 (and later the RTX 5090).

Both Nvidia and AMD had to build slower versions of their GPUs to try to keep revenue flooding in from China. This itself was a contentious move , with then-Secretary of Commerce, Gina Raimondo, saying "if you redesign a chip around a particular cut line that enables them [China] to do AI, I'm going to control it the very next day." They went back and forth on this approach a lot.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HbpHGCPC2QStf4yijLxgc8-1920-80.jpg

The good news for Nvidia and AMD was that it was President Trump who eased controls on GPUs, such as the H20 and MI308. Both chips were pared-back versions of existing chips, H200 and MI300, respectively, for the Chinese market in order to meet restrictions. The bad news was Trump said he'd do it in return for 15% of their China revenue . That was in August, 2025.

Whether either company sold any chips to China around that time is another matter, their respective CEOs suggest few, if any. Jensen Huang said in October, 2025, Nvidia was "100% out of China… we went from 95% market share to 0%."

AMD's CEO, Dr. Lisa Su, said in the company's Q3 earnings at the start of November that it had received licenses from the Commerce Department but that it hadn't included any sales in its Q4 guidance as it was still up in the air.

By December, 2025—yes, that's how quickly these things change—Trump eased controls on China again, allowing Chinese companies to make do with last-generation GPUs, such as the H200. To get their hands on them requires a thumbs-up from the US Department of Commerce in return for a 25% fee. One report suggested that Chinese firms were limited to 75,000 GPUs each , which was reportedly half of what shopping giant Alibaba and TikTok owner ByteDance had hoped for. Though Nvidia confirmed later that it had received orders from "many customers in China".
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hYpyAaA3sEs774SXS6x5mW-1920-80.jpg

This has proven a contentious move. Not only in the US, where national security concerns are paramount , not helped by reports that the US is approving sales to companies with empty offices and ties to possibly blacklisted entities; but also in China. The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) wasn't sure it even wanted the GPUs. It took a while to approve imports of the H200 and that wasn't even the end of it, as there was reportedly another hold-up for imports later on .

The CCP didn't sit back and watch this all unfold without action. It jumped between a policy of lessening reliance on US tech , building its own lithographic DUV and EUV machines, and making more efficient AI models, and blocking sales of specific cards , including blocking the RTX 5090 D v2 in China the day Jensen Huang was visiting . That sends a signal. Chinese authorities even launched an antitrust investigation into Nvidia's acquisition of Mellanox , which was linked to export restrictions and part of the tit-for-tat trade war between the two countries at various points in the past half-decade.

Long story short, and to cut out some of the bits where it wasn't really clear which chips could go where and to whom, there was a long period of time when Chinese firms couldn't officially get their hands on a lot of the most powerful GPUs.
But perhaps there was another way?
GPUs: the black market's hottest commodity
Throughout this entire period of export restrictions and policy changes, there were claims that companies and criminals were bypassing the whole lot of it.

Falsifying customs documents, diverting through third-countries, and purchasing under false pretences are all ways that one might get around the ever-changing export restrictions in both the United States and China.

The US Department of Justice seized more than $50 million worth of Nvidia GPUs from an American business attempting to circumvent export restrictions. Alan Hao Hsu, of Hao Global LLC, pleaded guilty to smuggling at least $160 million worth of Nvidia H100 and H200 GPUs between October '24 and May '25. Hsu and others are said to have used falsified shipping paperwork to try to ship the GPUs to China, Hong Kong and elsewhere in violation of US export controls.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9jEexcNHoo5AFgRz5iCAGf-1920-80.jpg

More recently, Malaysian customs shared it had seized $12 million worth of chips found in servers, which were headed for undisclosed countries in Asia. This is a hot topic for the US, which previously noted that it wants Malaysia to keep a close eye on shipments of any and all Nvidia chips in and out of the country, for fears of them ending up in China. A similar case saw two Chinese nationals arrested for exporting tens of millions of dollars worth of chips through Malaysia between October 2022 and July 2025.

A known name in datacentres, Supermicro, has also been mixed up in smuggling claims. The company's co-founder, employee, and a contractor were charged with conspiring to divert servers containing powerful AI chips to China, via a Southeast Asian country, in violation of export controls.

“The indictment unsealed today details alleged efforts to evade US export laws through false documents, staged dummy servers to mislead inspectors, and convoluted transshipment schemes, in order to obfuscate the true destination of restricted AI technology—China,” said John A. Eisenberg, Assistant Attorney General for National Security .

The contractor involved in the case pleaded guilty to the charges in a New York court in October, 2026. The Taiwanese authorities were also heavily involved in the case, working with Supermicro to investigate the company's local offices.

游戏剧情设定为本应轻松得手的行动将两位主角卷入一场横跨雷奥奈达的犯罪阴谋。杰森和露西娅这对亡命鸳鸯将在美国阳光最灿烂的地方，见识到它最阴暗的一面。若想活着逃出生天，他们比以往任何时候都更需要彼此依靠。

items.title: 乐高正在预告耀西套装，但你必须等到 2027 年
items.summary: We've seen Mario, karts, Mario on a kart, and lots more since Lego first teamed up with Nintendo, and at long

others.title: 乐高预告耀西 2027 年套装

content.v: We've seen Mario, karts, Mario on a kart, and lots more since Lego first teamed up with Nintendo, and at long last, everyone's favorite talking green dinosaur is getting his chance in the spotlight--not you, Denver . Never you.

While it's just a quick tease for now, the Nintendo Today app featured Yoshi poking his head out of frame. It's clearly the fan-favorite character, judging by the color of the bricks, the shape of his eyes, and what's clearly a big snout taking up space; and judging by the bricks used, this should be a sizable figure. That shouldn't be too surprising, because if it features the same complexity as the Lego Bowser and Mario Kart figures that were geared toward adult collectors, then this Yoshi is going to command a sizable piece of shelf real estate.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Lego-Yoshi-1.jpg

Just don't expect this Yoshi in time for the holiday rush, as the fine print on the left side of the image suggests it won't hit stores until 2027. There's no official pricing yet for the figure, but like all things Lego, expect to pony up quite a few bucks, as Nintendo-branded sets can cost a lot, depending on the figure's complexity and the number of bricks in the kit.

If you are looking for another Nintendo Lego set, there's been no shortage of them throughout 2026. Some of the highlights include the 2,234-piece Mario Kart: Luigi set that puts Mario's brother behind the wheel of the Mach 8, diorama-style Animal Crossing sets launched earlier this year, and alongside The Pokemon Company, there were plenty of Pokemon Lego kits to build.
Next year will also see the launch of a brand-new line of Super Mario minifigure-scale sets , which includes builds like Mario's Pipe Jump, Yoshi at Mario's House, and Fire Mario & Bowser's Castle.

items.title: 警察逮捕了父亲，因为他让 6 岁的孩子过夜排队，以节省口袋妖怪卡片的位置
items.summary: A South Carolina man has been arrested after allegedly leaving his six-year-old daughter in line at Target at

content.v: A South Carolina man has been arrested after allegedly leaving his six-year-old daughter in line at Target at 1 AM to save his spot for Pokemon trading cards.

As relayed by ABC News , witnesses said they saw John-Michael Dooley, 35, give his daughter a pillow and a blanket at around 1 AM last week before leaving her. After about an hour, customers, concerned for the girl, notified police.

Dooley came back to the store around 2:30 AM, was identified by other people in line, and was arrested by police. According to police, Dooley owned up to leaving his young daughter unattended in line so she could save his place in line.
South Carolina Social Services have taken the girl into emergency protective custody, and Dooley was charged with unlawful conduct toward a child.
Pokemon trading cards remain incredibly popular, with interest surging this year specifically , as people hunt for rare cards and then try to flip them for profit.
“It is one of our fastest-growing categories that we’ve seen and one of the largest contributors to [our] growth over the last number of quarters,” eBay executive Adam Ireland told CNBC .

items.title: 《赛博朋克 2077》刚刚推出了新的多人游戏模组，配有 RP 服务器
items.summary: Last month, Cyberpunk 2077 got an ambitious multiplayer mod, NightCoop. This is great if you want to play with

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/ss-f678ed77c2fe7060ac9c64e32e1472e3ec3ab7dc-1920x1080-1794240795931.jpg

Last month, Cyberpunk 2077 got an ambitious multiplayer mod, NightCoop. This is great if you want to play with up to eight players, going through the main story with friends. However, if you want something even more chaotic, we now have another multiplayer project: Open//77. This essentially turns Cyberpunk 2077 into GTA Online, letting servers of often more than 100 players mess around in Night City, getting up to various roleplay shenanigans.

Open//77 was just released in alpha, meaning that anyone can now download it and give it a try themselves. You need to own both Cyberpunk 2077 and the Phantom Liberty expansion for it to work, but as long as that’s covered, you’re able to experience this new take on Night City.

While NightCoop is great if you want a pretty vanilla game experience, albeit with multiple Vs running around, Open//77 is more like a big playground. You have different roles and different tasks to get up to than in the base game. As you can also see in the footage, you can play in third-person.

Night City opens on November 6. Light RP, the official Open77 @CyberpunkGame multiplayer server. Make your crew, race, run contracts, hit the casino, rob Arasaka, fight a world boss, outrun the NCPD. Friday, 22:00 UTC https://t.co/WpR4rB1DJA

It also looks like there’s more of a focus on just hanging out in the open world. One video shows players meeting up in a room they rented to play a board game. There are also more aesthetic features to play around with, such as an expanded vehicle customisation menu.
level -1 of the card shop: private rooms. neon deck, cozy lounge, tatami room. open one, send the code to a friend to play together https://t.co/OVy8ECkHuj

Vehicle customization is landing on Open77 @CyberpunkGame multiplayer. Any server can use it. RP, racing, car meets, whatever you're building. Open alpha and our Light RP server go live tonight, 22:00 UTC. https://t.co/Qrf2PLnoFt

Every server has its own theme. The most popular is NCRP, which supports up to 1,000 players looking to roleplay. Others are more combat, PvP focussed. Something to consider if you are interested is that Open//77 openly admits to using AI in the development process. Indeed, AI is why we are seeing so many fan-made projects like this released at once. It has divided the modding community , as many were making unofficial multiplayer mods like this long before generative AI was a factor. Earlier this month, Nexus Mods, the biggest platform for mods on the internet, reacted by enforcing mandatory disclosure for mods with AI-assisted code, and letting users filter AI-assisted mods out of their search criteria or preferences.

I tried Open//77 out, but it did not play nice with my heavily modded setup. Open//77 does support mods (and you can even temporarily download a host’s mods if you join their server), but messing around with my own mods so soon after having to fix them for the latest official update seemed a bit too daunting just now.

Wherever you land on projects like this, it’s no wonder there is an appetite for them. Cyberpunk 2077 was supposed to get an official multiplayer mode, but this was scrapped after the base game’s messy launch . A sequel is in development now, so we’ll have to wait and see if CD Projekt Red can make it work for that.

items.title: “软盘已过时，21 世纪科技已盛行”：FAA 终于放弃已有 55 年历史的存储设备
items.summary: Better late than never.

content.v: You've got to hand it to floppy disks. The now 55-year-old storage tech occasionally crops up in the most surprising of places, like a San Francisco light rail line or, previously, US nuclear launch facilities .

One last holdout appears to be the Federal Aviation Administration, which still uses the disks for data storage within the US air traffic control system (via Ars Technica ). Not for much longer, it seems, as US transportation secretary Sean P. Duffy has announced the widespread rollout of their long-overdue replacement.

"Good news America: floppy disks are out, 21st century tech is in," says Duffy in an FAA press release . "The greatest nation in the world deserves a state-of-the-art air traffic control system, and under President Trump, we’re delivering just that."

The ageing disks contain "vital weather and other critical information" used within the current air traffic control system, but that's set to change with the new Enterprise Information Display System (E-IDS).
"E-IDS gives air traffic controllers the information they need to make timely decisions and keep the flying public safe,” says FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pZq5tvCAseW2jMD6hmuQiW-1920-80.jpg

"We’re moving away from outdated, manual processes and replacing technology that once relied on floppy disks with a modern system that allows controllers to instantly share critical flight alerts, restricted airspace schedules and pilot reports across the National Airspace System."

E-IDS aims to improve the collection of pilot reports (referred to as PIREPS) and Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs), with the former representing first-hand reports on weather conditions from pilots to air traffic controllers, and vice versa.

One of the systems being replaced is called the Information Display System 4 (IDS-4), which appears to rely on floppy drive-equipped machines running MS-DOS. The FAA plans to complete the upgrade to the new system at 435 sites by the end of 2028, with Atlantic City International Airport and Nashville International Airport being some of the first locations to receive the new system.

Here's hoping the upgrade process goes smoothly, not least because I travel through US airspace on the regular. For giggles, I used this calculator to work out how many 3.5-inch, 1.44 MB floppy disks would be needed to contain the 30 GB base client of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 .
It's 20,834. With fun facts like that up my sleeve, don't you wish you were sitting next to me on your next flight?

items.title: 办了十年“中国之星”，索尼互娱终于拿真金白银“加注”了
items.summary: 尽管比往年晚了一些，今年索尼“中国之星计划”的发布会还是在11月3日如期举办。 这是索尼“中国之星计划”展开以来的第十年。 在这样一个关键节点，要说项目迎来了什么样的重大变化，无疑要数索尼用前所未有的力度，用真金白银给这

content.v: 尽管比往年晚了一些，今年索尼“中国之星计划”的发布会还是在11月3日如期举办。
这是索尼“中国之星计划”展开以来的第十年。
在这样一个关键节点，要说项目迎来了什么样的重大变化，无疑要数索尼用前所未有的力度，用真金白银给这个项目加了注——首先是向入选“中国之星计划”第三期的游戏《绝晓》追加了价值100万美元的项目投资；
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/8f1cd345426fc1787d4b5832b2d2a2d9.appmsg_mw680water
《绝晓》
之后更宣布，将对入选第四期 “中国之星”的每一个项目，都进行价值100万美元的项目投资。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/82d0436569b264b29449baccc09214ff.appmsg_mw680water
2026年“中国之星计划”发布会现场
此次也公开了加入第四期“中国之星计划”的两名新合作伙伴：DENMU電夢和S2G。
DENMU電夢是一家专注全球游戏行业的投资机构，我们此前就有对他们进行过 较为深入的采访和报道 。入选第三期“中国之星”的项目《达巴：水痕之地》就已收到来自DENMU的投资。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/f14d54ad7b1663242330bf241454e169.appmsg_mw680water
游镕畅（Ryan You） DENMU電夢管理合伙人兼CEO
S2G（Solutions 2 GO）则是一家提供全球游戏分销服务的公司，主要业务是将实体游戏、数字产品、主机和配件铺到世界各地的零售门店和电商渠道，并提供仓储、配送和零售推广服务——它还是PlayStation在拉丁美洲的独家分销合作伙伴。
S2G已计划协助第三期入选游戏《达巴：水痕之地》及《潜阈限界》的全球发行。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/5c10472ee44cf3801550d4d9dadee013.appmsg_mw680water
片方祐介（Yusuke Katagata） Solutions 2 GO Asia Vice President, Asia Publishing
正如发布会上索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司董事长兼总裁江口达雄所说，在PlayStation刚进入中国时，主要工作是将海外的游戏“引进来”，参与培育中国的主机游戏市场。
在这一过程中，他们也推出了“中国之星计划”，希望协助本土的主机游戏项目成长。
这件事一度看起来道阻且长，却在近年内随着《黑神话：悟空》《影之刃零》等优秀游戏作品的出现，加速了下一个命题的到来，也就是如何让中国的单机游戏进一步“走出去”。
面对这一变化，索尼终于有了动机和信心，用真金白银来加码对“中国之星”项目的投资。
那么对于国内正在开发中的单机项目而言，100万美金究竟代表着什么，除了“钱”以外，更迫切需要的又是怎样的帮助？
作为首批拿到这一投资的项目，《绝晓》与Playstation之间的关系是否有发生一些变化？
以及对于DENMU電夢、S2G这样的合作方而言，参与“中国之星计划”的目标又究竟是什么？
在发布会过后，索尼互动娱乐中国区游戏制作总监包波、《绝晓》制作人应超、DENMU電夢管理合伙人兼CEO游镕畅，以及S2G亚洲区发行副总裁片方祐介，与多家媒体进行了一场会谈。
交流过程中，诸多议题彼此交织，却也算是汇出了一条共同的脉络，那就是：中国的单机游戏发展，究竟还要有怎样的变化，才算是迎来真正的“春天”？
以下是此次采访的记录，为便于阅读，做了一定整理和删减。
Q：“中国之星计划”第四期最明显的变化是给到每款入选游戏100万美元的资金支持。PlayStation方面为什么选择在这个节点追加资金支持？预期希望得到怎样的回报？
包波 ：PlayStation增加对项目的投资，在一定程度上是对这个作品的一种背书，能够帮这些团队吸引到更多的投资人、发行商等优质的合作伙伴，主要是这个目的。当然PlayStation投资肯定能短时间内解决一部分问题，我们内部对这个经济回报的要求比较少，只是希望能够帮他们一把，支持中国开发者成长。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/0a9795809e19889adfad5d9bdb67a722.appmsg_mw680water
包波 索尼互动娱乐中国区游戏制作总监
Q：这100万美元可以实际解决什么问题呢？
应超 ：对开发者而言，100万美元肯定也不是小钱，甚至在以前，独立游戏单款制作成本可能100万美元就解决了，当然2A到3A这样的产品肯定需要更多资金的支持。
现在国内的投资环境，单笔100万美元也不是一个小数目，是一个正常范围，肯定能帮到很多事情的。另外由索尼互动娱乐来做这个事，跟单纯一笔资金投资的意义还是不太一样的，这还是游戏行业内一个比较资深的前辈认可，这是比较有帮助的。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/fd0a6e876fab3b78ef3afe034e507823.appmsg_mw680water
应超 《绝晓》游戏制作人
Q：这100万美元是作为项目投资还是股权投资？
包波 ：我们目前都是项目投资。
Q：中国之星计划又有新的合作伙伴，挑选合作伙伴的方法或者规则标准是什么样的？

包波 ：DENMU電夢、Solutions 2 GO这两个合作伙伴对中国之星计划的意义是很大的。我们中国之星计划入选的项目，很多面临的问题都是类似的，比如说海外的资源太少了，所以我们希望引入可以补齐这部分支持的合作伙伴。另一方面是很多入选项目是需要合作伙伴对游戏有判断能力的，能够提供有效的反馈。比如说DENMU電夢，他们有国际视野、也有专业的人对游戏进行反馈，这样的能力太重要了，这个对我们帮助也很大，对团队帮助更大。
Solutions 2 GO和PlayStation合作已经超过20年了，索尼互动娱乐在全球各地的办公室，其中有些就是和Solutions 2 GO一起建立的。
中国之星计划跟DENMU電夢、Solutions 2 GO这边的合作是水到渠成的。
Q：電夢和S2G为什么会选择成为中国之星计划的合作伙伴？希望从中达到什么目标？

游镕畅 ：我们跟索尼互动娱乐中国之星计划是非常契合的。因为我们在中国看的所有案子里面，中国创意非常多，但能够落地的其实很少，我相信未来肯定会慢慢更好，但是现在这个阶段，对于投资人来说，一个项目的想法很好、创意非常好、可能demo也非常好，但是要落地成一款游戏，这中间还是有难度，是有一定的跨越度。但中国之星计划能够把这块做好，这块我们没有后顾之忧，只用关注游戏的亮点怎么卖、怎么好玩，具体制作等一些问题我们就不用担忧。
片方祐介 ：中国之星计划的选拔已经帮我们筛过一轮了，所以到我们这边的其实都是能确保品质的，这一点对大家来说是比较安心的。另外，项目既然入选中国之星计划，就意味着肯定会得到很大力度的支持，包括后续游戏上市、宣发上都会得到索尼互动娱乐的支持，比如通过State of Play曝光，这个对我们来说也是非常好的一针强心剂。
Q：索尼这边给项目投入一百万美元，真的会让合作伙伴对这个事情更有信心吗？
游镕畅 ：一百万美元对于不同规模的项目来说，占预算比例可大可小，我们跟索尼互动娱乐的合作很多，PlayStation对于项目投资是很慎重的，他们愿意投资一百万美元给一个项目，这种背书对于我们合作伙伴来说是很重要的。
片方祐介 ：如果是中国之星计划扶持的一些游戏，在中国市场做一些落地的时候，索尼互动娱乐肯定会有些宣发的帮助，这就可以帮助游戏更好地获得更多的人气，日本也会看这个点，在中国这款游戏有没有人气、是不是受大家的欢迎，这一点对他们来说也是影响蛮大的。
Q：《绝晓》作为中国之星计划第三期的项目，加入计划之后整个团队和索尼互动娱乐之间经历了怎样的合作过程？对于整个团队来说，这100万美元的投资对接下来的开发计划会产生哪些实质性的影响，是不是会有一些因为资源或者预算限制而不得不暂缓的想法，然后在之后再重新提上日程？

应超 ：入选中国之星计划之后，这期间有过非常多的配合合作节点，我们定期会有一些版本，中国之星计划团队会帮我们看，也会有一些音频音效等支持部门帮我们做一些事情，包括做一些试玩。2024年、2025年我们都在ChinaJoy的PlayStation展台上做线下试玩，这是我们见玩家比较重要的时刻，也收到了非常多的反馈。游戏已经开发了好多年的时间，中间会有非常多的想法，最终是要能比较快速地介绍给玩家这款游戏是什么东西，需要把一些比较核心的点梳理出来。现阶段肯定不是去做发散，而是去做收敛。
我们不会说有了投资去做额外更多的东西，核心目标还是把这两三年时间见玩家，包括给其他一些业内朋友看的东西、收到的一些反馈，我们把它提炼出来，这是最重要的要集合进游戏的东西，把这些给做好。我们想做的东西不是一个非常大而全的顶级豪华盛宴，还是把最精华的精品东西基本盘做好，这是我们接下来最重要的事情。
Q：電夢是做游戏投资的，现在做游戏投资的美元基金还是比较少，专注于游戏的几乎没有，为什么还会专注在游戏这个赛道上？
游镕畅 ：游戏一年2000亿美元的收入，相比任何市场，游戏也一点都不小，其实很大，但是它在金融市场上的感觉比较小。我觉得游戏行业整个金融属性、财务属性和金融市场都有很多不契合的地方，虽然游戏市场很大，也是最重要的文化产业之一，但是你要用传统投VC、投科技的方式去投游戏，是很难有像科技一样的回报的。
我们想的是怎么解决这个问题？因为游戏行业也需要一直“输血”，也需要资金输进来。我们做的是只投游戏，所以我们整个结构、整个交易设计、整个架构、人力都是按照游戏行业来做的，我们给基金投资人最大的承诺就是你获得的回报和市场金融上的AI也好或者其他什么，都是不一样的，我们叫uncorrelated return，这样的话对他们来说是一个非常有趣的行业。
虽然有点像开玩笑，就是投其他行业的太多了，但游戏行业我们认为可以做的事情很多。
当然最后一个原因，我们特别喜欢游戏，我们认为人还是要做自己喜欢做的事情。
Q：这次加入中国之星计划，Solutions 2 GO是看中了中国游戏的哪些潜力？结合你们在海外市场的经验，你们希望从中国开发团队里面找到什么样的作品？
片方祐介 ：从现在整个游戏市场的趋势来看，包括刚才有提到《黑神话：悟空》《影之刃零》，像这些中国游戏在海外的反响都特别好，特别受追捧，所以我们也希望继这两个游戏之后，在中国市场上能找到更多这样的好游戏。
刚才大家也有提到《达巴：水痕之地》，这款游戏的背景源于中国西域文化，因为日本跟中国在文化上有一部分很相通的地方，相关文化对我们来说也是比较熟悉的一些东西。我们之前也有跟游戏开发商聊过这个游戏，当时交流时觉得非常感慨，当时准备了很多资料，我们现在看到的只是冰山一角，如果能够把这些资料的亮点、想法能够更好地传递给到海外玩家的话，那就最好不过了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14608/498b35e248ad464bb6737dc947858af0.appmsg_mw680water
动作游戏《达巴：水痕之地》

items.title: 《使命召唤》的搜打撤，让影视飓风Tim在野兽先生的视频里出现了15秒
items.summary: 野兽先生、影视飓风还有《使命召唤》……你可能很难想象这几个词被联系在一起，但当下的互联网就是这样奇妙。 作为油管第一网红的野兽先生，在两周前发布了为《使命召唤：现代战争4》（MW4）的多人模式“无人区2.0”制作的一期节

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/8e78870716e27de4ff487659d20e32ee.appmsg_mw680water
野兽先生、影视飓风还有《使命召唤》……你可能很难想象这几个词被联系在一起，但当下的互联网就是这样奇妙。
作为油管第一网红的野兽先生，在两周前发布了为《使命召唤：现代战争4》（MW4）的多人模式“无人区2.0”制作的一期节目：邀请了来自世界各地的20名网红，两两组队，在一个类似训练营的场景中游玩该模式，最终胜者可带走100万真实美金。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/afe9176e80f80294768f6b3d89226e6a.appmsg_mw680water
这样的游戏宣传活动野兽先生办过不少次。但这是少数有中国嘉宾参与的一次——国内的头部博主、此前也因iPhone Duo的评测视频而在推特上火速涨粉的影视飓风创始人Tim，也出现在了这期节目中。
然而，Tim在节目正片中出镜的总时长不超过15秒。原因看起来也比较纯粹——进入游戏后，他连一个敌人的面都没看清就被秒了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/11a7003e70f77e1dff558527b6c0c6b1.appmsg_mw680water
再到11月6日，Tim又在自己的账号“飓多多StormCrew”放了参与这次节目的更多幕后，以及对这个游戏的游玩感受。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/37f6ed643cf306e1893331d0ac194dc1.appmsg_mw680water
Tim也是这期节目中唯一使用键鼠的玩家
所以，即便是不上外网的中国玩家，应该也能感受到动视为这作《使命召唤》所做的大手笔宣传，以及背后所抱有的市场期待。
此前的剧情战役部分，也确实质量不错，拉高了路人的印象分。
但恰恰是在作为正餐的多人模式和“无人区2.0”（DMZ 2.0）上线、动视开足马力宣传之后，游戏的好评率却急转直下，从战役提前试玩期间的“特别好评”跌到了现在的“多半好评”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/c294e59f0e4729c09413e7af9ee05b28.appmsg_mw680water
这并不是因为玩法内容做呲了。正相反，DMZ模式不错的底子吸引来了大量玩家，却因而触碰并加剧了当下搜打撤游戏最核心的争议：面对PVE玩家和PVP玩家，你究竟想服务谁？
某种程度上来说：Tim只能在那期视频里出镜15秒，也正是这一矛盾的缩影。
DMZ 2.0的玩法框架，特别是PVE部分，可以说是做得有模有样；相比此前的DMZ Beta，更可谓质的飞跃。
DMZ Beta推出于2022年，在那个市面上的“搜打撤”产品还都叫“类塔科夫”的年代，它算是当时最鼓励“战斗爽”的“类塔”玩法。虽然是以大幅弱化搜索和类RPG长线养成要素为代价，玩家成长幅度受限，但换言之成型也快，推PVE任务拿到高级护甲就敢去干架，死亡惩罚也很低。
不过这套玩法的深度值得商榷，养成内容的缺失，使得组队清图杀玩家成了后期的唯一乐子。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/c748825aa4d6fed2e4a26970916692c1.appmsg_mw680water
发布于2023年11月的官方公告，啰嗦一大堆就是为了停更DMZ Beta
今年的MW4则是跳过1.0，推出了2.0。或许也是吸取前作教训，DMZ 2.0大改游戏循环，疯狂填充PVE要素和后期养成内容。
在局外，玩家终于有了成型的基地，可以花钱改枪、购买物资，也能将材料投入基地的3D打印机，升级基地的各项功能，或者制作战斗道具。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/2d5c63cdbe600150cdeec13b6733089e.appmsg_mw680water
自带靶场的基地
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/f9850885c5fc1408b3b3fdec190ad5b7.appmsg_mw680water
3D打印机可以打印各种战斗装备
引入基地建造和道具制造的设计，放大了局内搜索的快感。白色品质的材料用量很大，但搜索时会自动拆解放进背包，不占背包格子。除了贵重换金道具，像是制作战斗道具的配方、解锁武器使用和改造权限的手册，也算高价值战利品。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/e2ab4766b2a158e14611f81b178713d0.appmsg_mw680water
DMZ 2.0又引入了天赋树，玩家扮演的干员下图升级，即可从“战士”“侦察兵”和“生存专家”三条天赋树中，选取一部分天赋以强化自身的战斗和生存能力。
比如我选择的普莱斯点了提升撤离直升机速度的技能，跑路飞快，被开黑的朋友称作“法国队长”。而“战士”线有项终极天赋允许死亡玩家原地复活，于是现在的玩家们都习惯了在敌人尸体上布设地雷，防止诈尸。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/c2990a0e6c2ebb80f4bfd09c5c2c1662.appmsg_mw680water
撤离失败的干员算作“失踪”，玩家可以选择花一笔钱赎回干员，保留天赋等级；或者直接解雇，重新招募一位白板干员。等级练满的干员还能“转生”，于清空天赋的同时，随机获取一项不会随玩家解雇而消失的永久天赋，最多获取3个，也就是转生3次。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/fa629943bc50249920bbcdb47613751c.appmsg_mw680water
玩家最多可以拥有3个干员槽（购买“金库版”则是4个）
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14606/f3af96b23b2e23140512f2d10eb4d0f8.appmsg_mw680water
永久天赋一般都是重要节点天赋的上位版本
能从这些养成内容中看到许多竞品的影子，但也无法否认， 这些养成要素的缝合延展了肝度和深度，为DMZ玩法的“搜”和“撤”这两块短板赋予了更深层次的意义。
这也有助于DMZ 2.0将“打”的长板呈现得淋漓尽致。
COD做了这么多年，在“打”这一环节从未拉跨。
好比系列一脉相承、由“年货”流水线打造的顶级Gunplay，是DMZ不可忽略的加分项，仅是用这些武器随便射点目标，都能让FPS粉丝们产生十足的爽快感。
枪战爽游的本色
COD对大型地图设计的理解也比较深刻。DMZ 2.0将舞台放到了架空城镇“河津市”，和Beta的“马兹拉”相比，这张地图更贴合搜打撤的玩法调性，区域安排更紧密，建筑排布和道具刷新更合理——我真的能在在警局搜到武器，在医院搜到药品，在银行搜到保险柜。
DMZ 2.0继续沿用Beta的毒圈规则，半小时后辐射范围会准时扩大把人赶出战局
地图中的大型据点结构更为复杂，好在IW围绕这些据点设计了“剧情任务”，在承接战役剧情的同时，方便玩家熟悉据点内部构造。
配合杀不完的高威胁AI敌人和巧妙的脚本演出，每个剧情任务的体量都能撑起15-30分钟的单局体验。流程也都很有趣，像是在高新科技园的摩天大楼之间玩伞降和跑酷，亦或是闯入朝鲜军事禁区的地堡大闹一番……
将病毒代码注入广播塔摧毁无人机，这段疑似致敬《消逝的光芒》
最终任务中，我们小队乘坐武装快艇，在直升机和RPG小兵的围追堵截下胜利大逃亡，让我怀疑这些任务有没有掺杂战役的废案。
枪林弹雨，火光漫天，就，很COD
所以虽然名为剧情任务，但它们具备一定的重玩价值。 同时大型据点内含丰富战利品，选择剧情任务进入匹配时，玩家小队默认刷新在离任务据点最近的复活点，等于快人一步。
而且剧情任务匹配池碰到的敌对玩家很少，现版本有6个剧情任务，即地图上最多刷6队。部分任务还会设置独立撤离点，降低了被人截胡的可能性。除非有“猛攻哥”故意不做任务找人杀，否则产生冲突的概率很低，再加上不做任务也不会受到任何惩罚，所以“鼠鼠”玩家可以反复接任务跑刀爽吃。
“铁堡行动”的军事基地吃得最爽，也最受社区欢迎
相比之下，“动态行动”和“漫游”两大匹配模式都不太平，因为全图最多刷新20队人，反而更适合“猛攻哥”发挥。
全图范围用于侦测敌人的无人机塔都在工作，可见PVP压力有多大
不过动态行动发放的金钱奖励无需撤离带出，而是直接到账，降低了获利风险，同时任务数量管够，在地图上近乎无限刷新。
同样讲究风险与回报的设计，还有继承自前作的Boss狩猎机制。击杀地图上的Boss，会掉落狗牌和稀有武器，带出狗牌即可获取大量金钱奖励。狗牌位置会实时显示在所有玩家的地图上，供其他小队参与争夺，不喜PVP的玩家倒也可以绕着狗牌走。
用好道具能够有效降低杀死Boss的难度
Boss掉落的狗牌在地图上高亮显示

items.title: 【白夜谈】群友一句玩笑，我真去万智牌公开赛“挨打”了
items.summary: 我也要打十年吗…？ 半年前，我开始玩万智牌。整个五一假期我都在MTGA（《万智牌：竞技场》，万智牌的官方数字版）度过，那时我抄了一套红蓝元素的标准套牌，吭哧吭哧地打天梯。实话说，我打什么游戏都不爱打排位，这几乎算得上我第

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/7330e220951a5f8d2be6beb14ccbe55a.appmsg_mw680water
我也要打十年吗…？
半年前，我开始玩万智牌。整个五一假期我都在MTGA（《万智牌：竞技场》，万智牌的官方数字版）度过，那时我抄了一套红蓝元素的标准套牌，吭哧吭哧地打天梯。实话说，我打什么游戏都不爱打排位，这几乎算得上我第一次这么「想赢」。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/a4aa00286d2d7926f8837eb17fd6c3c2.appmsg_mw680water
我那段时间跟人聊天几乎只有这一件事
在十天后，我上了秘稀 （MTGA最高段位） 。我兴高采烈地把排位截图发给带我入坑的对象，他又转发给朋友。随后牌友们在群里连发问号，开玩笑说「这不给人报个GP」。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/cd67aed3ce713c73c0b51ca36863e81f.appmsg_mw680water
GP，即Grand Prix，曾是万智牌大型公开赛事的代名词。它的报名没有资格限制，新人也可以直接参赛。如今赛事体系几经调整，类似规模的比赛改名为聚光灯赛。
没想到半年后，我还真报名了北京的聚光灯赛。
真正决定参赛之后，我首先要决定自己用什么套牌。纠结了很久，甚至抱着打不过就加入的心态，我把此前遇到过的强势套牌抄来试了试，结果都玩得一塌糊涂。考虑到备赛时间有限，最后还是决定用自己最熟悉的红蓝元素。
但由于犹犹豫豫，迟迟下不了决心用什么套牌，等我终于想好去闲鱼买牌时，一套价格美丽的红蓝元素已经被人买走了。我暗自懊悔，真是先下手为强。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/cf920c4403e2bffa43ec3b3f63f3c2d5.appmsg_mw680water
没办法，只好先四处借牌。我找玩EDH的朋友借了几张双色地，又去牌店老板那里买了几张，最后求助对象，他把自己近十年的牌本逐一翻过去，竟然真掏出了十几张能用的牌——那时我感觉自己简直是「东市买骏马，西市买鞍鞯」的花木兰。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/72b7415010a4f23c3eaf637a22a274bf.appmsg_mw680water
眼看比赛临近，我终于绝望地打开淘宝，把缺的牌一张张加入购物车。此时我对万智牌的昂贵终于有了实感，原来去打趟牌，要花上几千块钱。
结果就在我准备忍痛付款的时候，对象突然传来好消息，他找朋友借到了一套基本齐全的红蓝元素。我如蒙大赦。
到了北京，比赛前一天，我在赛场闲逛，听见旁边两个人正在讨论换备牌的策略。我越听越觉得熟悉，忍不住凑上去问他们玩的是不是红蓝元素，结果还真是。那时候我还缺一张牌，就顺口问了问他们有没有多余的，没想到真从他们手里买到了。
第二天早上9点开赛，我8点多就得起床打车。十月底的北京清晨秋风萧瑟，寒气刺骨，微弱的阳光照在脸上也不觉得暖和。我下了出租车，一边呵气搓手，一边往赛场走，心里却有种久违的紧张和亢奋。真像高中参加重大考试的时候啊。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/aa92cf9188199b094b61010574537c72.appmsg_mw680water
好久没见8点钟的太阳
费尽周折凑齐了牌，真正坐上赛场，我才发现，线下打牌比想象中难不少。
第一轮是红蓝元素内战。在第一局，对手起手抓了一把法术，顺风顺水地开始展开生物战，我却怀疑自己赛前没把牌洗开。除了三张地，接下来摸到的几乎全是高费生物。整套牌里也就12张生物，我看过的13张牌里竟然出现了8张。
想抓的牌一直没上手，但是不需要的牌却一直往手里钻，后面几个回合变成纯粹的坐牢。我不停地喊让过，一直戴着痛苦面具。与此同时，我在默默许愿：求求了，下一张洗开了吧，让我操作一下吧！
结果又是一张生物。我翻了无数个白眼，心想自己在对手眼里，肯定算不上什么扑克脸。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/20ef6a8df79f1f9f145b46fd3d9e7ab6.appmsg_mw680water
我估计当时自己是这个表情
第二轮打蓝黑掘坟，情况倒是好了一些。有一局，我把对手的血量压到了5点，自己场上有六张地，手里还有一张Traumatic Critique。只要再摸到一张地，就有机会直接赢下比赛。
可惜，此前对手用Duress、Deceit之类的弃牌手段反复干扰我的手牌，搞得我心神不宁，总觉得手里的资源随时可能被人拿走。明明离胜利近在咫尺，我却急着把它打了出去。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/e40e8f84bfa7d6ec93b3ce90ea36936c.appmsg_mw680water
回头想想，刚开始打得实在有点呆。一局没把牌充分洗开，另一局好不容易摸到了当时最想要的牌，却又没能把握住。
但在那个当下，我确实很难控制住自己，因为现实打牌和MTGA实在太不一样了。
MTGA的玩法几乎是「哪里亮了点哪里」。对手每进行一个操作，只要轮到我可以响应，屏幕上就会出现倒计时，提醒我此刻拥有优先权——我只需要考虑此刻到底要不要行动。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/40fff4fae748f8812b0702ad584be59d.appmsg_mw680water
在堆叠上的牌也看起来也非常清晰
但是现实打牌，我得自己维护场面，记住有哪些异能需要触发，留意对手的每一个动作，还得在适当的时候主动提出响应。有时对手还会反复提醒游戏阶段，我一被催促就自乱阵脚，原本可以再捏一捏的牌，也稀里糊涂地提前打了出去。 换作MTGA，我早就把对手静音了。
这使我意识到，自己线上打过的那些对局，可能还远远不足以让我从容地坐在一张真正的牌桌前。
当然，后来也有一些顺利的对局。当我渐渐习惯了赛场的嘈杂，也摸索出了这套牌在线下该注意哪些事情，那些对局之外的要素，终于不再占据太多注意力。万智牌好像又重新变得好玩了。
我打起精神，一直打到第一天最后一轮。最终成绩是4胜4负1平，对于第一次参加大型比赛的新手来说好像还算体面。虽然没能进入第二天，但我还是喜气洋洋地把成绩分享给了所有知道我最近开始打牌的朋友。
还有一件事让我印象很深。虽然比赛时我几乎全程盯着场面，没怎么留意对手，但打完之后，我竟然能记住每一个和我交过手的人。后来在会场里走来走去，只要再次碰见，总能一眼认出来。
明明只是隔着一张桌子打了几十分钟的牌，甚至没说过几句话，却好像已经建立起了一点微妙的联系。我似乎有些理解，为什么那些经常一起打牌的人，会对彼此有那么深的印象，又为什么一场场比赛过去，原本陌生的人会渐渐成为朋友。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/c0728364cc04b86ce3fcad35bf0bf9eb.appmsg_mw680water
第一天比赛前官方宣布了中文回归，或许我会拥有更多新手牌友…？
比赛结束后，我也开始羡慕起那些厉害的牌手。比如Wenbo，他是我对象的朋友，也是半年前在群里起哄让我去打GP的人之一。这次比赛，他一路闯进八强，拿到了PT （Pro Tour，职业巡回赛） 的参赛资格。
聊起来才知道，Wenbo第一次参加大型比赛，居然也是在北京。那是2016年的春天，他刚上大一，一个人坐着过夜的二等座来到北京，借住在同学宿舍里。结果第一次打GP，他就进了Day 2。
他回忆说，当时刚从高中毕业，第一次有了一个可以独自出远门的理由，感觉很新奇。比赛中又赢了不少厉害的对手，获得了很大的认同感和满足感。那时候他就觉得这个游戏他会打很多很多年。
一晃十一年过去。他曾好几次倒在八强门前，只差一场胜利，那些自己再打好一点就能赢的对局，回想起来尤其难受。这次终于拿到了PT资格，他很开心。「终于没再犯错了，而且因为没犯错，运势也来到了我这里……总而言之，我现在是一个打万智牌的Pro了。」
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14603/d3ca168816270fb48cd4ca764d17af97.appmsg_mw680water
这次比赛前，我也稍微了解了一下高水平牌手的训练方式。他们要大量测试不同套牌，反复练习各种对局，研究换备牌的策略……相比之下，我的备赛完全是临时抱佛脚。但想到他们为一场比赛投入的时间和精力，又实在有些望而生畏。
不过Wenbo告诉我，他也并非一直充满热情。大学毕业后，他曾有一段时间在准备出国，没有工作。后来又碰上疫情，好几年都没怎么认真打竞技万智牌。他也怀疑过，自己大学时是不是在这件事上花了太多时间。但最后想想，还是觉得有这么一个爱好胜过没有。「那些时间如果不花在万智牌上，我应该也不会投入到其他所谓更有意义的事上。」
这些年，万智牌也让他认识了许多朋友。刚入坑时结识的牌友，有些直到今天还在一起打牌。这次北京比赛，他们也约着一起吃了涮肉。Wenbo说，自己其实是个很容易慌乱、被压力压垮的人，但万智牌已经成为他生活中相当稳定的一部分。它让他有理由和朋友保持联系，带他去各种各样的地方，甚至成了他向圈外朋友介绍自己的一个标签。
赛后他在朋友圈写道，最近有很多半途而废、想做好却没做好的事情，幸好还有这么一个坚持多年的爱好，让他看到了结果。而最美妙的时刻，是最后一轮前与同伴碰拳，获胜后有朋友在台下欢呼、拥抱他，还有许多人发来消息庆祝。「这个时刻自会铭记终生。」
听打牌多年的朋友带着怀念的语气讲述自己的经历，不管是印象深刻的对局，还是那些比赛之后的聚餐，或是那种「玩了这么久，还是这群人」的感慨，我都会涌起羡慕的心情。
我像是一个站在门口张望的人，真心希望自己也可以拥有那样珍贵的经历，也能够「play the game, see the world」。
不过眼下，我还是觉得打牌本身最好玩。
我喜欢万智牌的瞬息永恒，享受智胜对手的强烈正反馈，乐于跟不打牌的朋友分享它富于变化的系统、不同颜色的气质和隐喻。
甚至连一开始让我懊恼的运气成分，我也渐渐开始欣赏了。连胜和连败，不过是茫茫多概率事件中的一种。你当然可以尽力做出正确的决策，但没办法保证每一次都得到想要的结果。如何面对这些波动，我觉得也是一种对心智的磨练。
想到这里，我又有点期待下一次比赛了。

items.title: 动作游戏难度不够直观？这游戏做出了个好点子
items.summary: 索尼今年4月发售的独占射击大作《沙罗周期》，在不久前的10月19日推出了大型免费更新“天顶”（Zenith）。 我们在之前也介绍和讨论过这款游戏， 芬兰开发商Housemarque用接近3A的成本和规格，挑战制作了一款在

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/9510dcaa0e4063e04ab2ac4920690cd7.appmsg_mw680water
索尼今年4月发售的独占射击大作《沙罗周期》，在不久前的10月19日推出了大型免费更新“天顶”（Zenith）。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/5bd1c52bcc85ac4e18d1d91f23dd5958.appmsg_mw680water
我们在之前也介绍和讨论过这款游戏， 芬兰开发商Housemarque用接近3A的成本和规格，挑战制作了一款在当下相当小众的“街机型”动作射击游戏。我个人是挺喜欢这款游戏的，通关了也一直留在PS5上，时不时会搓上一把。
这次的更新主要聚焦在玩法层面，包含全新的Boss Rush模式“霸主模拟战”，以及多周目玩法“日蚀层级”，进一步加强了游戏的重玩性。也加入了慢速模式、自动射击模式等新功能。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/8c2680d9acd1ce80d72a443fc9646343.appmsg_mw680water
完成一周目的主要内容后，可以在最终Boss战的场景里见到通往下周目的门，也能随时切换回这个一周目的存档
进入多周目后，玩家将失去之前收集的所有局外成长要素，并面对数值和进攻欲望更强的敌人。
同时，游戏中的官方修改器“卡尔萨修正项”也会多出20个全新的可选效果，其中10个提供正面防护——比如可以减少复数敌人进行同时攻击的情况，或者击败敌人后掉落更多经验，加速多周目下的成长；另有10个挑战性的试炼效果——像是护盾只有在精准弹反下起效、角色总共只能受击两次等等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/efc94acbeb7c2225231a9b53fb611f7e.appmsg_mw680water
还有随机调换操作按键等等
“卡尔萨修正项”在默认状态下要求玩家平衡选择增益和负面效果。但在游戏的设置选项里，玩家还是可以开启官方提供的作弊选项——就不需要正负相抵也能应用自己选的效果了。
这里就要说到这次“天顶”更新中最有趣的一个设计。
在玩家进入多周目后，主角亚炅头部会显现一个黄金王冠，代表着他在剧情中被“黄岸”（原型为克苏鲁神话里的旧日支配者黄衣之王）侵染；而玩家选的负面修正效果越多，这顶王冠就会越大越醒目，甚至让主角眼睛放光。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/a0432327db342686ce2a3b6b3e6ca06b.appmsg_mw680water
多周目不同难度下的王冠状态
不仅如此，在二周目中，游戏还加入了少量的新剧情要素——由一些藏在不同地方的壁画来讲述，而这些壁画只在顶着大王冠的玩家眼前才会显现。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/04f2af1a5633fe71d75bfcb7728436d6.appmsg_mw680water
可以说这是一个在视觉趣味性、玩法挑战和叙事层面做出了相当巧妙结合的设计。
这一周里，我们参加了对《沙罗周期》的创意总监Gregory Louden和设计主管Tinari的线上采访。他们介绍了这个点子是怎么来的。
Abebe介绍说，他们最初只是想让玩家在进行直播或是展示截图时，能够直观表现他选了怎样高的难度、开了多少负面效果。
这其实正是《沙罗周期》发售后遇到的一个比较尴尬的状况——由于官方提供了堪称“宝宝巴士”的作弊难度，导致一些玩家觉得该作深度不如前作《死亡回归》。
但依照一些硬核玩家的评价，由于提供了近战模式和更多可选武器，《沙罗周期》其实有了更高的操作上限——前提是你自己开启那些更有挑战性的选项。
由于画面中缺乏直观的难度显现，所以双方进行相关讨论时缺乏锚点，结果往往如鸡同鸭讲。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/b78dda3e0a31c5f193b2ea55ed86a649.appmsg_mw680water
比如面对满屏弹幕，主播实际上可能开了类似一触即死的负面效果，但不明情况的观众可能会说“那开盾挡了不就行了，还能攒能量”
这也不止是《沙罗周期》所遇到的问题。
这类动作射击游戏就和早先的《忍龙》等动作游戏一样，属于只有同样内行的深度玩家，才能看出一个视频里的操作者对于“九死一生”的处境做了哪些精妙的处理；而一般路人观众除了弹幕密度之外，很难感知到游戏挑战性在哪儿。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/b41f506843fadad892f59a7a935dddad.appmsg_mw680water
这两天《影之刃零》关于“哪个流派才是最强轮椅”的讨论，也从另一个角度印证了动作游戏的这个困境
Abebe说他们最早想到的是一些老游戏里常见的“大头模式”——他记得以前玩PlayStation和N64上的游戏，输个秘籍，角色的脑袋就会变大。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/7fc5d5d068dd956451677624232f1f72.appmsg_mw680water
近期CS2也恰好更新了“大头模式”，玩家击杀数越高，角色的头就会变得越大
之后美术负责人提出：把变大的东西换成王冠。这样一改还连上了游戏的叙事内容。Abebe甚至觉得，显现的王冠诱惑着玩家去证明自己的技巧和力量这件事，也和故事里的黄衣之王做的事对应上了。
在当下这个直播时代，这种能直观显现难度的设计我觉得还挺有学习价值的——尤其是如果也能找到合适的形式，做到像这样与叙事有机结合起来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/23a2b1ba3ce554d96298a4c515217722.appmsg_mw680water
小岛秀夫的《合金装备5幻痛》中有过一个恰好相反的设计：玩家让角色戴上小鸡头套的话，游戏内的敌人就会对其视而不见，极大降低游戏难度
在这次采访中，我们也和Housemarque的两位讨论了游戏里的一些其他设计，Abebe和Gregory同样非常直率地分享了这些设计背后所经过的思考。
不过，与系列以及工作室长期发展有关的提问都被婉拒了——考虑到《沙罗周期》的商业表现并不太出色，这多少让人有些担心这类游戏将来的发展。
所以还是延续上次那篇文章最后所说的：对于这类动作射击游戏，实属且玩且珍惜，喜欢的玩家不妨多多支持；也希望执着于这类游戏的开发者们，有机会找到属于自己的市场突破口。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/a75a2703a66afb148425c00641088da7.appmsg_mw680water
Abebe
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14609/08af01b4215b897f45d54d3cf043356a.appmsg_mw680water
Gregory
以下是此次采访的问答内容，为便于阅读做了一定整理。
Q：“Zenith”有最高点的意思。这次更新怎样拓展了《沙罗周期》的故事和世界？战斗和系统有哪些最大的变化？制作这次新内容的主要目标是什么？
Abebe Tinari： 我们考虑给这些新内容起什么名字时，就像你说的，“Zenith”表达了达到最高点的感觉。其中一部分体现在“霸主模拟战”里，也就是Boss Rush模式。我们想挑战玩家，能不能在连续面对这些敌人时做到最好。
我们也希望整个更新围绕一个主题，让玩家尽可能发挥自己的水平。所以在“日蚀层级”里，我们加入了使用越来越多“卡尔萨修正项”的挑战，让玩家磨炼技巧，挑战战斗系统的不同方面。
至于战斗系统的变化，核心部分没有改变。仍然有三种子弹，也保留了原有的武器和防御手段，不过我们增加了一些改变战斗体验的方式。
首先，在日蚀层级中，肾上腺素系统得到了扩展。原来最高是5级，到了日蚀层级2，最高可以达到8级；到了日蚀层级3，则可以达到10级。我们的想法是，既然玩家要面对更高的难度、使用更多试炼修正项，也应该给他们一些变得更强的工具，帮助他们克服这些挑战。
Q：现在更新已经推出，你们是否愿意更直接、明确地说一说，《沙罗周期》究竟想讲一个怎样的故事？
Gregory Louden： 我们想为《沙罗周期》创作一个神秘、令人难以忘怀的故事，希望它给玩家留下疑问。所以，如果你问我们最终会不会清楚解释每件事的含义，答案是不会。我们希望把这些留给玩家。
让我很受鼓舞的是，除了对故事很表面的解读，也有一些非常深入、用心的理解。我觉得很多人理解了我们想讲的故事。
我可以说的一点是，“归来时变得更强”不只是在说玩法，也是在说亚炅作为一个人，怎样从错误中成长。从这个角度看，这也是一次对角色的探究。
但归根结底，游戏本身比我更适合告诉你这个故事。我们有想讲述的故事，也有它的真相，不过我们希望让玩家自己发现。我们想创造一种神秘感，玩家自己找到答案，比我们直接告诉他们更有收获。
Q：游戏平衡难度的方式很特别。玩家会不断犯错，却仍然愿意从每次失败中学习，一遍遍尝试，停不下来。这是怎么做到的？
Abebe Tinari： 难度是个很难讨论的话题，不过我觉得你概括得很好。刚开始玩的时候，玩家还没有完全理解护盾、腐化和黄色子弹是怎么回事，很多东西都不太清楚。第一个Boss就像是对这些机制的一次测试。如果你能用好护盾、从弹幕中获得力量，就能作出更有力的反击。
很多玩家会在某个时刻突然理解这些机制。比如，满血时腐化很危险，但血量降低之后，就可以承受腐化，从中获得大量力量。我们会把这些系统逐步叠加起来。
之后又会加入红色子弹，也就是Nova弹。刚遇到时，它们最可怕，因为你不能用冲刺穿过去。但等到学会弹反，它们突然又变成了反过来对付敌人的机会。
另一个方面是修正项系统。我们是在问玩家，你已经掌握了基础，那这个能做到吗？那个呢？我们给玩家一些小而有趣的挑战。

就像电影《林中小屋》讽刺的那样，一个偏远小镇上，几个作死的少男少女结伴而来。发现诡异之处后，这群人分头送死，然后在只剩男女主角的时候逃出小镇——简单来说，就是又一个模板化的恐怖故事。

所以，当我听说《银松镇》是个类银河城游戏时，这份由名字而来的刻板印象就瞬间消散了。我很难想象，在一款游戏里， 生存恐怖和类银河城这两个类型要如何融合。
毕竟这两个类型听起来是有点互斥的，《生化危机》《寂静岭》这样的生存恐怖游戏里，探索是一种冒险行为，捉襟见肘的资源和未知的Jump Scare，都让玩家不敢往前。但在《恶魔城》《空洞骑士》等类银河城游戏里，探图既是动力也是最大的正反馈，游戏永远都在鼓励玩家探索。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/fb2b6acf0b4d684bb536d0838c452c29.appmsg_mw680water
《银松镇》典型的类银河城地图
两种类型一个在限制玩家，一个在奖励玩家，却在这款游戏里形成了相互支撑的自洽。体验《银松镇》的过程中，我对于“恐怖游戏要怎么做成类银河城”的疑问，也慢慢有了答案。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/d9a12efe96c577faaadc71b1b30f11e9.appmsg_mw680water
游戏发售一个月后，好评率仍然高达95%
就像开发团队Wych Elm向我介绍的游戏目标一样：玩家越想弄清楚这座小镇，就越需要承担继续探索在各种意义上的代价。
“如果把《生化危机》和《寂静岭》做成2D版，大概也就是这个样子吧。”这是我在通关游戏后，发给朋友的第一句话。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/825189ac2c9c0f44b66fe186523b3984.appmsg_mw680water
但在刚刚打开《银松镇》时，我对它呈现恐怖的形式还充满疑问。
类银河城作为一个2D横版视角的游戏类型，注定了恐怖感无法像3D游戏那样形成“贴身”的压迫感。但制作组却觉得，这种能跳脱出角色的视角，能更好地呈现主角和环境关系，通过精心安排的构图和视野调控，更好地引导玩家注意力。
用他们的话来说，就是“它能给小镇留下足够的表现空间，让它像一个角色那样被描述”，得到一个“活”的银松镇。
制作组最初想做的，是一个带有新黑色电影气质的“小镇故事”。他们是先构想出这个世界，再寻找适合它的玩法，这才有了生存恐怖和类银河城的组合。所以在《银松镇》的开发初期，Wych Elm早早就想好了要用横版视角的有限视野，搭配上类银河城环环相扣的地图来撑起整个游戏。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/221c5e44e2fd67167549b63ec130ae9e.appmsg_mw680water
开发过程中的概念图
我们都知道，类银河城的乐趣，来自玩家对同一片空间的一次次重新认识——也就是玩家遇到走不通的道路、拿到新能力、再迫不及待回头解锁。探索由此形成一种节奏：发现问题、暂时搁置、再带着新的能力与信息回来。
但在《银松镇》里，生存恐怖游戏的规则又让这个循环变得更加“刺激”。
它不只要求玩家探索一座小镇，还要让玩家在探索的每一步都衡量风险。游戏里的锁钥，是不同阶段拿到的小刀、斧头或是大锤，它们既是解锁每个区域的关键，也和子弹、伤药一样是会被消耗掉的资源。
很多时候，把你卡在一个区域的不是“门要从另一侧打开”，而是你明明可以畅通无阻，却因为武器耐久不足，被一个怪物拦住。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/46f96beccdc6338ad627976c38f0842b.appmsg_mw680water
子弹够不够闯过去，也是一种隐形门锁
在“格子危机”方面，《银松镇》更是把资源管理带来的恐惧与焦虑做到了极致。
和《生化危机》里用打字机无限存档不同，这个游戏的存档点是路边的公共电话亭，只不过玩家每次存档，都需要消耗一枚硬币——就连存档机会，也是用一次少一次。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/a4af285912bbf21bcfddfa6d34d1df39.appmsg_mw680water
前期我就因为存档次数过多，导致连一株草药都买不起
聊到游戏给玩家带来的物资焦虑，主创还告诉我，他们确实总在利用资源分配为玩家营造出恐惧，但与此同时，他们也不会把玩家一直压在资源匮乏的状态里。
资源不足时，玩家会格外谨慎地探索地图；资源充裕时，玩家则更容易倾泻子弹放松警惕。就像那句恐怖片的定律一样，人在放松的时候最容易被吓到，所以他们更想让玩家在保守与冒进之间摇摆，这才会得到最好的恐怖“受众”。
这种走走停停的探索节奏里，玩家对类银河城地图的一点点解锁，自然就成了他们对未知恐怖发起的一次次挑战。探索与恐惧在这个过程中，不断强化着彼此，地图越是展开，值得追查的线索就越多，玩家越是熟悉小镇，就越容易意识到自己还有多少事情没有弄明白。
这种玩家身处的恐怖氛围，正是他们希望得到的叙事空间。
很多玩家通关《银松镇》后，都喜欢把它和《心灵杀手》或是《双峰》等作品的气质进行比较——用玩家的话来说，它们都是“有些神叨叨的小镇悬疑”。
这些故事里，异常都潜藏在最为寻常的生活场景中，人物与事件之间似乎存在联系，却又难以被一种简单的解释串联起来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/a9801bd8c1c0e3bf99c4d8cb5b5cd3ef.appmsg_mw680water
《双峰》剧照
《银松镇》的故事，是一位私人侦探受人之托，去到小镇上找寻一名失踪的歌手。但是随着他对这个小镇的探索，侦探逐渐发现自己也陷入了一种难辨真假的灾祸之中。
和许多类银河城游戏一样，游戏也把很多补充的叙事片段拆成碎片，作为探索奖励放在地图的各个角落。布告栏上贴着的失踪人口公告，咖啡店老板留在自己的备忘纸条，都是玩家解锁真相的拼图之一。
甚至在游戏过程中，玩家还会多次在路过的电视里，看到两部游戏原创剧集的片段，就像《心灵杀手》里的内置美剧《夜泉镇》一样，它们也都是补全剧情的关键。当然，这也是换了一种方式在讲谜语。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/e079bd2b9978fff51d5ed2e4e4bbe664.appmsg_mw680water
网上已有玩家解包提取出了原片
据游戏的主创介绍，《双峰》和斯蒂芬·金的小说《雅各布之梯》等作品确实是他们重要的灵感来源。正式开发时，团队成员们又重新审视这些作品，并试图理解它们的氛围为何如此特别。
他们觉得，要让这样诡异的故事和世界成立，美术就不能只负责营造恐怖气氛，还必须让场景本身显得可信。所以在《银松镇》里，他们选择以“转描动画”的形式来表现人物和场景。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14611/464f68a99ad530f535f4d388db1b5e98.appmsg_mw680water
主角的身形和动作，都是由真实照片转描而来。场景的搭建上，主创们也希望玩家在2D视角的有限画面里，依然能够看到背景里未来他们能够探索的地图，让看似平面的画面呈现出更完整的空间感。
通过美术风格上的把控，游戏中的人物和场景都更加可信。
游戏内场景
只不过在此基础上，他们又会在人物身上赋予很重的阴影，即便这种阴影不一定符合当下场景光照。主创解释说，他们希望给予的主角很强的形体感，希望主角既能基本融入环境，又“保留着微妙的异质感”。
这种主角和场景间不够和谐的美术风格，正是他们想要的“兼具黑色电影气质与不安感”的视觉风格。
不管是美术风格还是叙事上，《银松镇》都在强化着“可信度”，却同时要在其中藏着一个让玩家无法忽视的“疙瘩”。在世界高度可信的前提下，再让一切变得疯狂。
一个似真似幻的酒吧
随着玩家逐渐了解剧情，我们会发现自己依然不知道故事的第几层才是真相；当我们逐渐熟悉地图，也依旧无法确定自己是否彻底理解了这片区域。
制作组就是想让玩家在战战兢兢的探索中，不断收集线索，接着发现线索带来的不只是答案，还有更多需要解释的问题。
这种始终无法严丝合缝的不确定性，正是《银松镇》在游戏的叙事与探索结构之间最重要的连接点。
